strengthLegend.title: Card Strength & Points
strengthLegend.note: 10 > A > K > Q > J > 9 > 8 > 7 (same for trump and non-trump). 60 points total.

hint.lead_low: Lead a low card to conserve points
hint.follow_win: Points on the table — win the trick
hint.discard_low: Cannot follow suit — discard a low card

tutorial.trickDisplay: This is the current trick. You must follow the led suit. When void you must trump, unless your partner already holds the trick (the trump-conservation exemption).
tutorial.playerHand: This is your hand. Click a playable card to select it.
tutorial.playButton: Once a card is selected, play it with this button. Manille has no declarations — the only action is playing a card.
tutorial.info: The 10 (Manille) is the strongest card and the A (Manillon) is second, then K>Q>J>9>8>7. Points: 10=5, A=4, K=3, Q=2, J=1 (60 total). Trump is the suit of the last dealt card. Team A (seats 0 & 2) vs Team B (seats 1 & 3) fight over card points; the first team to reach the target points (default 101) wins.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
